author: Inside Edition
description: Prison psychologist Nathalie von Zelowitz is sharing the unsettling story of one of her patients: a man who ate human flesh. Despite the horrific nature of his crime, she says 'Bernard' is actually very shy. She's been meeting with him for over a decade at the French prison where he lives, and says he's come out of his shell. "At the beginning, he was never making jokes, he was never laughing, he was never smiling. Now, he's making jokes," she told Inside Edition Digital.
title: Prison Psychologist Says Her Cannibal Patient Is 'Shy'
